mentions.name: NYC Coffee Map
mentions.description: A React Native mobile app and React web app that maps all the coffee shops across New York City. Opening the app instantly displays the closest coffee shop to the user, and it integrates Google Maps review AI summaries to give a rundown of each coffee shop's vibe.
mentions.source_excerpt: React Native mobile app + React web app that shows all the coffee shops across New York City. The idea is that you can open it and the app instantly displays the closest coffee shop to you. It integrates with Google Maps reviews AI summaries for a lowdown on the coffee shop and vibe.
